Tally functions

A tally function counts how often it was called.

In this article

  • First

Counting with a closure

A function made inside another function keeps the variables of the outer one alive:

js
function makeTally() {
  let total = 0; // stays alive between calls
  return () => ++total;
}

const tally = makeTally();
tally(); // 1
tally(); // 2

Note: Each call to makeTally() starts a new, separate total.

Closures in loops

With let, every pass of the loop gets its own binding:

js
for (let step = 0; step < 3; step++) {
  setTimeout(() => console.log(step), 10);
}

Warning: With var, all three callbacks print 3.
